subject: Taxes
title: The Hut Tax War
description: One-minute skill: The Hut Tax War.

hook.text: In 1898, Sierra Leone's British rulers imposed a tax on every hut. The Temne and Mende people went to war over it.

buildup.text: The hut tax forced Africans to earn British currency to pay.

discovery.text: Chief Bai Bureh led armed resistance. Warriors used guerrilla tactics that frustrated British troops for months.

twist.text: Britain crushed the revolt and executed hundreds. But the hut tax became a symbol of colonial exploitation worldwide.

climax.text: The Hut Tax War showed that colonial taxes were tools of forced labor. The tax wasn't revenue—it was control.

punchline.text: Tax the hut, force the labor. Colonial taxes were chains by design.

quiz.question: What was the real purpose of the colonial hut tax?
options: Force Africans into wage labor for colonizers
